scope: All 65 remaining standalone čto tokens after EDIT-0019, plus the five prose copulas hidden among 250 standalone su/Su forms.
choice: Recast 64 non-interrogative Russian-calqued čto constructions sentence by sentence; preserve the one genuine interrogative pronoun. Change five prose copulas su to sut while preserving 245 mathematical su/Su symbols byte-exact.
motivation: Official čto is an interrogative/relative pronoun, while the reader repeatedly used it as a Russian-style sentential conjunction or discourse connector. Transparent to/ktoro/tym/pri čem/ravnoznačno constructions preserve the German logic without privileging Russian syntax. Interslavic third-person plural of byti is sut; mathematical indices and symbols named su/Su are not language tokens.
alternatives_rejected: Blind čto-to-že substitution, because the 64 contexts express consequences, relative clauses, equivalence, parenthetical assumptions, or discourse linkage rather than one complementizer relation.
Blind su-to-sut substitution, because 245 of 250 forms are protected mathematical notation.
Retaining sentence-level Russian syntax merely because čto itself is an official pronoun.

evidence.official_grammar_disposition: čto retained only as the genuine interrogative in 'pytanje, čto možno rěkti'; sut used only for third-person-plural prose copulas
evidence.source_review: All 88 original čto tokens accounted for: 23 QED formulas repaired in EDIT-0019, 64 repaired here, one interrogative retained. All 250 su/Su forms accounted for: five prose copulas repaired, 245 mathematical symbols retained.
